note: Where each frozen source document came from. Deliberately records no hashes: documents.jsonl holds the authoritative source_hash, and scripts/verify_sources.py joins on (document_id, revision) to check that the URL still serves exactly those bytes. Duplicating a hash here would create a second place for it to be wrong. GitHub URLs are pinned to a commit rather than a branch, because the fastapi branch URL no longer reproduces the frozen source.

documents.note: Superseded by pep8@v2. This URL returned a 404 HTML page large enough (5407 bytes) to pass a size sanity check, and it entered the corpus unnoticed. The error page has itself changed since (5442 bytes on 2026-09-18), so not even the failure is byte-reproducible. Retained because pilot-5-v0 and pilot-9-v1 ran against it. On 2026-09-18 the URL returns an HTTP 404 status rather than a 200 with a body, so the fetch now fails outright instead of silently yielding a plausible file.
